name: FAQ, sticky notes
description: Questions as tilted, taped sticky notes on a pinboard. Opening a note shows the answer on it.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Everything people ask before their first class

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: We pinned the answers by the kiln room door. Here is the same board, minus the clay dust.

itemFields.name: question
itemFields.label: Question
itemFields.default: Can I book a private session?

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer
itemFields.default: Yes. Email the studio and we will find a time that suits you.

default.question: Do I need any experience?
default.answer: None. Most people who walk in have not touched clay since school. Week one starts with a pinch pot, not the wheel.

default.question: What should I wear?
default.answer: Clothes you would garden in, and short nails if you want to throw. We lend aprons. Clay washes out, glaze sometimes does not.

default.question: When do I get my pots back?
default.answer: About three weeks after you make them. They dry for a week and are fired twice. We email you when they reach the pick-up shelf.

default.question: Can I bring my kids?
default.answer: Saturday family sessions welcome ages 6 and up with an adult. Evening courses are for ages 16 and over.

default.question: What if I miss a week?
default.answer: Tell us by noon the day before and you can sit in on another group that week, or use a free practice slot on Sunday.

default.question: Are the glazes food safe?
default.answer: Yes. Every glaze on the studio shelf is lead-free and fired to 1,240 °C, so your mugs can go in the dishwasher.
